meaning: Finite interpretations for the fourteen derivations of round 2: for each premise other than excluded middle, a hand-written Unit (or two-respect Bool) model, checked by decide without axioms, in which the other premises hold and the conclusion fails; and one joint model in which a thought occurs and its bearer exists, exercises intellect, opines, causes and is in act of esse, with every premise and conclusion of the batch holding. Satisfiability and omission only; no model is claimed to describe reality.
